name: Light → On Turn On
description:
An automation to perform when the light is turned on. See [`light.on_turn_on` / `light.on_turn_off` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/light/#light-on_turn_on_off_trigger).

This trigger is activated each time the light is turned on or off. It is consistent with the behavior of the `light.is_on` and `light.is_off` condition above.
